description: The formats to shoot this week: the week's picks, then the rest of the week. Each format: what its videos do, its strongest video (link, views, poster), how it has spread and its page; a pick also names the recent hit behind it (`this_week`). Narrow by `category` or `platform`. Signed in, the person's own week leads. Then shorti_format(format_id) for how to shoot one.

category.description: The creator's niche, when they have one: beauty, food, fashion, daily, comedy, dance, music, pets, fitness, travel, art, gaming, product, info, ai, household, tech, parenting.

lang.description: The creator's language. 'en' answers in the English Shorti wrote: never translate its Korean yourself.

platform.description: Only formats with videos on this platform.

name: shorti_what_to_shoot

for_you.description: true when a signed-in reader's own week leads the list

refusal.description: why nothing was answered, by name

week.description: the Monday (KST) the week's picks are fixed on

title: What to shoot this week
